message: Night 2 I followed player_9 and they went to player_4. Player_4 was then struck by a sigil, so that visit fits a sigilist placing a sigil better than an investigator check on them. I have no vote lean yet, so I want to hear from player_1, player_5, player_7 and player_8 first.

player_3, yes, I followed player_7 on night 2, so I did come to them, and I saw them go to player_8. player_7, on night 3 I followed you and you visited no one, so your check on player_5 didn't happen. Player_3, what did your watch on player_7 show on night 3?

I'm the Investigator. Night 1 I checked player_8: not suspicious, so player_8 isn't a wolf. Player_3 says no one visited player_4, and player_4 says player_3 visited them; they can't both be right, and a follow shows where someone went, not who came to your own door. player_4, if you followed player_3, who visited you?

Player_3 was killed by the wolves on night 4, and player_1 is the one who visited player_3 that night. player_1, what did you do there, and were you blocked? I'd vote player_1 today unless they can explain that visit.

player_4, that visit was me: I watched you on night 1, and a watch is a visit, so you saw me there. Nothing came to you that night. I'm the sentinel, and I still have one watch left. Player_5, player_6 and player_8 have all claimed roles, so I'll weigh them before I decide where to watch next.
I'll go first with a result: I'm the trailseer. Night 1 I followed player_6, and they went to player_7. Since player_6 was the sentinel, player_7 should say what that visit was about.

My vote today is player_1. They claim sigilist and say a sigil on player_3 did nothing on night 4, but player_3 was killed by a wolf that same night, so that account needs a reason. Player_10's follow shows player_1 at player_3's door, and player_1 has not said what they did there beyond the claim. player_1, who visits a wolf's target and says it did nothing?

The record says player_1 carried the kill on night 1, so player_8's sigil claim fits. player_5, your check on player_8 is worth tracking if player_8 is a real sigilist. player_4, if you followed player_3, you would only see where player_3 went, so your 'player_3 visited me' line is the thing to explain.

player_3, yes, I followed player_7 on night 2, so I did come to them, which matches your watch. That follow showed player_7 went to player_8, matching their night-2 check claim. player_7, my night-3 follow on you saw no visit, so your check on player_5 didn't happen. Which is it?

I'm not going to vouch for anyone's door. player_4, you've given the same follow result twice, but player_3 has given a watch result that says the opposite, and one of you is off. I'll say my own night: I'm the Vigilante, and I held my shot on night 1. player_7 has been unusually silent and is the one nobody has tested, so I'd test them before the vote.

player_7, you said last day you'd check player_5 on night 3, but player_5 was killed by the wolves and no check result came out. Did you actually use that check, and on who? Answer that before anyone votes on player_8 or player_9.

player_10, the 'only unkillable body is the Necromancer' step is weak: a sigil death on night 1 tells us the struck player attacked, not who is unkillable. I did nothing on night 1, so I have no result to offer. Who did player_8 sigil, and what did player_6 see when protecting player_10?

player_7, you said your last check went on player_5 last night. What did you get back, or were you blocked? Your night-2 check on player_8 is still the only one you have a result for, so I want to know if the night-3 one actually happened before I vote.

Player_2 is dead, and my night-2 watch on player_7 saw player_2, player_5 and player_10 come to them. Since player_5 is the healer, the attacker was player_2 or player_10, and that makes player_10 the one living suspect from that visit. player_10, what did you go to player_7 for on night 2?

I'm the sigilist, so player_1's claim is false. I placed no sigil on night 4 and kept both. player_1, if you went to player_3 on night 4, what did you actually do there? A sigil claim that had no effect means you were not the one with the sigil.

Player_8's sigil claim fits the record, and my check on player_8 was Not suspicious, so they are not a wolf. The player_3 and player_4 dispute is the thing to resolve: player_4 says player_3 visited, player_3 says a watch found no visitors. I'd lean toward testing player_3's claim, since a Sentinel watch and a Trailseer follow cannot both be right. I'm open to a vote on player_4 if nothing better shows up.

player_10, I'm not sitting on anything. I did nothing on night 1 and have no result to share. Pushing a vote onto me on a theory about who can't be killed on night one is thin. Who do you think is lying in the player_3/player_4 fight, and why?

player_4, you and player_3 cannot both be right about a follow, so the next thing to check is whether anyone else saw a visit at player_3's door. Until someone adds a result, I'd treat the follow claim and the denial as equally unproven.
(passed)

player_10, I did nothing on night 1, so I have no result to give anyone and I'm not claiming a role yet. The sigil-struck death doesn't point at me; I'd rather see who backs up their night claims before we vote anyone. What do you base the push on besides the kill?

player_4, your follow of player_3 can't be checked, while player_3's watch on you saw no visitors. A fake follow is the only way both can be true, so I'd vote player_4 today. I'm not claiming anything yet.

player_4, I raised player_7 because the only death was a sigil and the Necromancer is the one body that can't die on night one, not because of silence. Your follow dispute matters more. If you followed player_3, where did player_3 go, and did anyone else visit you?

I'm the Investigator. Night 1 I checked player_8: not suspicious. Player_4, your follow says player_3 came to you, but player_3's watch says no one came. Player_3, you first said you visited no one, then said you watched player_4. Which one is it? I'd vote player_4 today unless that gets explained.

player_4, you asked what I did at your door: I didn't go there, and I'm not going to make up a story to fit your follow. Your result says player_3 visited you, and player_3 says they watched you and saw no one. One of you is wrong about the direction, so I'd test that before pushing silence on player_7.

player_3, my night-2 follow on player_7 is a visit, so your watch seeing me is accurate on that. player_7, last night I followed you and you visited no one, so the night-3 check on player_5 you announced did not happen. Which night was your check really on?

Night 3 is the cleanest test here. player_10's follow on player_7 saw no visits, so no check went out on player_5. player_3, if your watch lasted that night, who came to you? A watch that saw nobody would clear your claim against the wolf visit on player_5.

player_10, I'm not the one who has to be hung for a quiet first night. Nobody is cleared by an unannounced attack, and a sigil on a wolf carrying the kill is what killed player_1. Who do you think carried that kill, and why do you want the vote on me before player_3 and player_4 settle their wording?
(passed)

I'll say it since the floor's open: I'm the trailseer. Night 1 I followed player_6, and they went to player_7. player_6 is dead now, so player_7 should say what they know about that visit before we decide who to trust.

player_1, you say you were a sigilist on player_3 on night 4, but the wolves killed player_3 that night, so a sigil there would have had no reason to trigger. Tell us where you went on nights 2 and 3, and what your sigil did, so player_10's follow can be checked against it. I'd vote player_1 today unless that account lines up.

Night 1 I checked player_10, Not suspicious. Night 2 I checked player_8, Not suspicious. Both checks are spent, so I had nothing on night 3, and my day 3 plan to check player_5 was wrong. player_10, your Trailseer claim and player_3's Sentinel claim can't both be true, so which one do you think is lying?

I'm trailseer. Last night I followed player_6, who is dead now, and they went to player_7. Could be a watch or nothing, but player_7, what did you do on night 1? Anyone who has a result from last night, post it so we can line up the claims.

I'm the Healer, and I protected player_10 on night 1 with no public save, so either no attack came or player_10 is the Necromancer. player_3 and player_4 cannot both be right: a Sentinel is never told of its own watch, so player_3 saying an empty door proves nothing either way without a second claim. I'd test player_8's sigil claim against player_1 being a wolf before anyone votes.

The record backs player_8's sigil claim, since player_1 died to a sigil with no save. Player_5 and player_6 are both making role claims, so I'd like to know if player_5's check on player_8 means player_8 is cleared, and whether player_6 protected anyone who was actually attacked on night 2.

player_4, I was wrong to say I visited no one: I did go to your door on night 1. What I did there stays with me for now. So your trailseer report may be real, and I'll stop calling it impossible. player_5 and player_6 are the claims I'd test next, since their checks and protections can be tested too.

player_4, you keep quoting the result but not what you did at the door. If you followed player_3, the follow result names where player_3 went, so the question is whether you ever saw a visit at your own door. player_3 says the watch was empty, and that is checkable against who else claims a visit. I'm not taking sides yet.

Night 3 is the thing to pin down. player_4 died through player_2's body, so the Necromancer is alive. player_7, if you visited nobody on night 3, then your night-2 check on player_8 is the only result you have given, and it needs to stand on its own.

player_4 and player_3 cannot both be right about the door, so the table should stop arguing it and watch for the next night reports. player_5 and player_8 both have live claims, so whoever checks or watches the other's claim should say so. I have nothing to add on night results yet.

player_4, yes, I was the one at your door last night, but I was watching you, so I'm not the visitor you saw. My watch showed nobody else came to you, which is a fact you can check against your follow. Let's see who else's night lines up with that.

Looking at night 2: my watch on player_7 saw player_2, player_5 and player_10 come to them, and player_2 was a wolf, so one of the two remaining visitors was the attacker. I'd vote player_10 today. Player_7, what did your night-3 check on player_5 show?
(passed)

I'm player_10. Last night I followed player_1, and they went to player_3, who was killed by the wolves. I'll share my follows: player_9 visited no one on night 1, player_7 went to player_8 on night 2 and visited no one on night 3. player_1, why did you go to player_3 last night?

player_7, you said you'd check player_5 tonight, and I'm watching that. player_8, you say player_7 checked you on night 1, but player_7 says night 1 was player_10. Which is it? Let's see tomorrow's result before anyone votes on a claim.

Player_7 says they checked player_10 and player_8 on nights 1 and 2, and that the save on player_7 matches the report. I'd vote player_10 today: they pushed hard on player_7's check nights, and I have a reason to think they visited player_7 on night 2, the same night the healer was there. Player_10, where did you go on night 2?

player_7, you say you checked player_10 on night 1 and player_8 on night 2. An investigator has two checks, so you have none left for night 3. Then what was the 'last check' you are holding for a split? player_8 also says you checked them on night 1, which would be a third check. Which nights did you actually check?

I'm the Healer, and night 1 I protected player_10 with no public save. Player_3 and player_4 can't both be right: a watcher is a visit, so player_3's empty-door watch and player_4's visit can't coexist. I'd vote on the one whose claim is contradicted by the other, not on who is quiet.
(passed)

player_4, yes, that was me. I'm the sentinel and I watched you on night 1. The watch showed no one else came to you, which is consistent with your claim of a visit from me and no attack on you. I have one watch left and will use it where it helps the most.
